notes: Fixed the bot asking too little for items that were just raised. Real-trade proofs from before an item's last value change can no longer lower an ask below your normal demand-based minimum. Only proofs from after the change can. Example: Green Queen of the Night was raised from 80k to 90k, and almost all its proofs were older. Re-scored at the new value they said +1.9%, so a 1-for-4 went out at +2.8%. It now asks about +9.5% to +12.5%. Older proofs can still raise an ask.
